home.locationPrompt: Oggolow location-kaaga si aad ula socoto waqtiyada salaadda
home.adhkarDoneAgain: Maanta waa la dhammeeyay ✓ · taabo si aad mar kale u akhriso

common.comingSoon: Qaybtan waa la dhisayaa — waxay imanaysaa marxaladda {phase}.

prayer.gateBody: Waqtiyada salaaddu way ku kala duwan yihiin dal kasta iyo magaalo kasta. Marka aad shiddo location-ka, DIIN si toos ah ayay u ogaanaysaa meesha aad joogto, kadibna waxay ku tusaysaa waqtiyada salaadda ee goobtaas.
prayer.retry: Waan shiday — isku day mar kale
androidSteps: Hoos u jiid kor shaashadda, taabo Location si uu u shido.
Kadib: Settings → Apps → DIIN → Permissions → Location → Allow.
iphoneSteps: Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → shid.
Hoos ka hel DIIN (ama Safari) → While Using the App.
prayer.comeBack: Marka aad shiddo, ku soo noqo — si toos ah ayaan kuugu xidhi doonnaa.
prayer.privacy: Goobtaada cid kale looma diro — xisaabtu waxay ku dhacdaa gudaha taleefankaaga.
prayer.unsupported: Taleefankan ama browser-kan goob (GPS) ma bixiyo.
prayer.methodNote: Waqtiyadan si toos ah ayaa loogu xisaabiyay goobtaada, iyadoo la raacayo habka ay muslimiinta gobolkaagu isticmaalaan: {method} · Casarka: {madhab}. Markaad dal kale u safarto, waqtiyadu si toos ah ayay isu beddelaan.

listen.dlError: Lama soo dejin karin — isku day mar kale.
listen.error: Codka lama heli karo. Hubi internet-ka, ama dooro suurad aad horey u soo dejisay.
listen.source: Ilaha: Quran.com API — /resources/recitations iyo /chapter_recitations (faylasha QuranicAudio). Codka si toos ah ayaa loo dhageystaa; suuradaha aad soo dejiso offline ayay shaqeeyaan.

quran.sourceNote: Ilaha: Qoraalka — Quran.com API (text_uthmani, Xafs). Tarjumaadda Soomaaliga — Mahmud Muhammad Abduh (Quran.com, id 46). Taabo lambarka aayadda si aad u calaamadiso.
quran.loadError: Quraanka lama soo rari karin. Hubi internet-ka marka ugu horreysa, kadib wuxuu shaqayn doonaa offline.

adhkar.author: Xisnul Muslim · Saciid bin Cali bin Wahf Al-Qaxdaani
adhkar.fixedCount: Tirada ({n}) waxaa laga qaaday qoraalka kitaabka.
adhkar.noMeaning: Dhikrigan waa aayado Quraan ah — macnahooda ka eeg qaybta Quraanka (tarjumaadda Soomaaliga ee Mahmud Muhammad Abduh).
adhkar.meaningSource: Ilaha: Xisnul Muslim – Dhufeyska Muslinka (tarjumaadda af-Soomaaliga)
adhkar.tapHint: Taabo goobada si aad u tiriso. Waxaa haray {n}.
adhkar.reachedNext: Waad gaadhay! Dhikriga xiga ayaa imanaya…
adhkar.source: Ilaha: Xisnul Muslim (Saciid Al-Qaxdaani) — qoraalka Carabiga iyo tirada: hisnmuslim.com (API-ga rasmiga ah). Macnaha Soomaaliga iyo tixraacyada: "Xisnul Muslim – Dhufeyska Muslinka" (islamic-invitation.com).

wird.gridHint: Taabo maalin si aad u calaamadiso. Bogagga: Mushafka Madiina (604 bog).
wird.ring: {c} juz oo ka mid ah 30 waa la dhammeeyay

khatma.noHistory: Weli khatmi la dhammeeyay ma jiro. Marka aad dhammayso, halkan ayuu ku keydsami doonaa.
khatma.notifText: Waa waqtigii akhriska Quraanka 📖 – Maanta: Juz {juz}, bogga {a} ilaa {b}.
khatma.behind: Maalmo ayaad ka dib dhacday — dib u qaybi {pages} bog {days} maalmood
khatma.redistributed: Qorshaha waa la cusbooneysiiyay: bogga {from}–604 ayaa loo qaybiyay {days} maalmood (≈ {per} bog maalintii). Dhammaadku isma beddelo.
khatma.note: Bogagga: Mushafka Madiina (604 bog). Qaybuhu waa bogag isku dhow oo loo qaybiyay maalmaha.

notify.title: Ha seegin waqtiyada muhiimka ah
notify.body: DIIN waxay kuu soo diri kartaa xasuusin xitaa marka App-ku xidhan yahay. Adiga ayaa dooranaya kuwa aad rabto, waadna demin kartaa mar kasta.
notify.khatmaNote: Waqtiga aad ku dooratay Qorshaha Khatmiga
notify.iosBody: Ogeysiisyadu waxay shaqeeyaan kaliya marka App-ka lagu daro Shaashadda Hoyga:
iosSteps: Taabo Add, kadibna ka fur DIIN Shaashadda Hoyga
notify.testSent: Ogeysiis tijaabo ah ayaa la diray.
notify.denied: Ogeysiisyada waa la diiday. Waxaad ka beddeli kartaa goobaha (Settings) browser-ka ama taleefanka.
notify.unsupported: Browser-kan ma taageero ogeysiisyada. Isku day Chrome ama ku rakib App-ka.
notify.notConfigured: Server-ka ogeysiisyada weli lama dejin (eeg README). Inta laga dejinayo, xasuusintu waxay ka muuqanaysaa gudaha App-ka marka uu furan yahay.
notify.inApp: Marka App-ku furan yahay, xasuusinta salaadda halkan ayay ka soo muuqanaysaa xitaa la'aanteed server.
notify.error: Wax khalad ah ayaa dhacay — isku day mar kale.

install.title: Ku rakib DIIN taleefankaaga
install.body: Waa bilaash, wuxuu shaqeeyaa internet la'aan, wuxuuna kaa qaadanayaa meel yar.
iosSteps: Taabo badhanka Share (laba-jibbaarka leh fallaadha kor u socota)
Hoos u dhaadhac oo dooro “Add to Home Screen”
Taabo Add — DIIN waxay ka soo muuqan doontaa Shaashadda Hoyga
androidSteps: Dooro “Install app” ama “Add to Home screen”
Xaqiiji — DIIN waxay ka soo muuqan doontaa shaashaddaada

update.ready: Nooc cusub oo DIIN ah ayaa diyaar ah

welcome.title: Ku soo dhawow DIIN
welcome.body: Gal akoonkaaga si horumarkaaga, khatmiga, wirdka iyo adkaarta, uusan u lumin, oo aad uga sii wadato taleefan kasta.
welcome.guestUpgrade: Ku xir akoon si horumarkaagii hore loogu kaydiyo. Waxba kaa lumi maayaan.
welcome.passwordNote: Samee password cusub oo DIIN u gaar ah. Ha isticmaalin password-ka Gmail-kaaga.
welcome.notConfigured: Gelitaanka weli lama diyaarin. Fadlan mar dambe isku day.
welcome.offline: Internet ayaa loo baahan yahay marka ugu horreysa ee aad gasho.
welcome.forgotBody: Geli email-kaaga, waxaan kuu soo diraynaa link aad password cusub ku samayso.
welcome.forgotSent: Haddii email-kan akoon leeyahay, link ayaa loo diray. Eeg sanduuqaaga iyo Spam.
verifySteps: Ku soo laabo halkan, si toos ah ayaad u galaysaa
welcome.verifyUnsent: Email-kan weli lama xaqiijin. Haddii aadan helin link-ga, taabo “Dib u dir”.
welcome.verifySpam: Ma arkin? Eeg galka Spam ama Junk.
welcome.verifyNotYet: Weli lama xaqiijin. Fadlan marka hore taabo link-ga ku jira email-ka.

privacy.title: Siyaasadda Asturnaanta
privacy.subtitle: Waxa aan kaydinno iyo sababta
what: Horumarkaaga: khatmiga, wirdka, meesha akhriska, adkaarta
privacy.why: Si horumarkaagu uusan u lumin marka aad ka baxdo app-ka, aad taleefan beddesho ama aad dib u rakibto, iyo si app-ka loo hagaajiyo.
privacy.who: Adiga iyo maamulaha app-ka DIIN oo keliya. Xogtaada lama iibiyo, xayeysiisna looma isticmaalo.
privacy.place: GPS-ka waxaa loo isticmaalaa waqtiyada salaadda oo keliya. Haddii aad daarto ogeysiisyada, goob la soo koobay (qiyaastii 1 km) ayaa server-ka loo diraa si ogeysiisku waqtiga saxda ah kuu soo gaaro. Magaalada iyo wadanka waxaa laga garanayaa shabakadda internetka (Cloudflare).
privacy.deleteBody: Mar kasta waad tirtiri kartaa akoonkaaga iyo xogtaada oo dhan.
privacy.deleteConfirm: Ma hubtaa? Akoonkaaga iyo horumarka la kaydiyay waa la tirtirayaa, dibna looma soo celin karo.
privacy.deleteFail: Tirtiriddu ma suurtagelin. Hubi internetka, kadib isku day mar kale.
privacy.password: Gelitaanka waxaa maamula Firebase (Google). DIIN iyo maamulaheedu ma arkaan password-kaaga.
privacy.deletePassword: Si aad u xaqiijiso inaad adigu tahay, geli password-kaaga

account.title: Akoonkaaga
account.signOutConfirm: Ma hubtaa inaad ka baxayso? Horumarkaagu wuu kaydsan yahay, marka aad dib u gashana waad helaysaa.

admin.title: Dashboard-ka Maamulaha
admin.notConfigured: Furaha dashboard-ka weli lama dejin (eeg README).
admin.overviewSub: Booqdayaasha, soo degsiga iyo horumarka isticmaaleyaasha

_review: Erayada Soomaaliga waxaa qoray AI; waa in uu dib u eego qof af-Soomaali ku hadla ka hor daabacaadda.

auth.shortPassword: Password-ku waa inuu ahaadaa ugu yaraan 8 xaraf.
auth.wrongCredentials: Email-ka ama password-ka waa khaldan yahay.
auth.emailTaken: Email-kan hore ayaa akoon loogu sameeyay. Taabo “Gal”.
auth.weakPassword: Password-kan waa daciif. Dooro mid ka adag.
auth.tooMany: Isku day badan ayaa dhacay. Fadlan sug dhowr daqiiqo.
auth.network: Internet-ka hubi, kadib isku day mar kale.
auth.popupBlocked: Browser-ku wuxuu xiray daaqadda Google. U oggolow, kadib isku day mar kale.
auth.otherMethod: Email-kan wuxuu ku xiran yahay hab kale oo gelitaan. Isku day habka aad hore u isticmaashay.
auth.mismatch: Akoon kale ayaad gashay. Fadlan isticmaal akoonkaaga saxda ah.
auth.generic: Wax khalad ah ayaa dhacay. Fadlan isku day mar kale.
